title: NCRTC adds 8 fast (limited-stop) Namo Bharat services on the Delhi-Meerut corridor from Monday 16 Nov 2026: stops only at Sarai Kale Khan, Anand Vihar, Ghaziabad, Begumpul, Modipuram; whole corridor in under 50 minutes (NCRTC); Anand Vihar-Ghaziabad 8 min, Anand Vihar-Begumpul 36 min, Ghaziabad-Begumpul 28 min; departures from both ends at 8 am, 8.30 am, 6 pm, 6.30 pm; regular trains every 10 min unchanged; ~1.1 lakh daily passengers.
headline: NCRTC: 8 Fast Trains From Monday, Delhi-Meerut Under 50 Min
